summary: Closed Phases 4-8 of the theorem-library tableau pipeline in seven commits. The five stages of records/theorem-library.md now run end to end as one command, and the library has its first machine-generated entries: at the ruled bound over a two-atom pool the run decided 3,955 formulas and admitted six non-subsumed schemata, wrote 2,981 gated refutations in the countermodel record's form without admitting them, and registered 2,895 non-admitted outcomes as 48 aggregate conjecture cells. lake build BimodalLib and the full lake build are both green, with all three build-time assertions passing including the prefix-scoped assert_no_subsumed_entries. Phase 7 is COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS: the ModalTemporalBoolean tail (424 of 1,688 decided) was truncated by an untimed CERTIFY stage, and the planned dual declarations have no referent since no temporal schema survived admission.

artifacts.summary: Phases 4-8: the Lean-source emitter, the five reserved-stage diagnostics emitters, the stage driver with its executable target and named entry point, the ruled-bound run with admission, and the documentation revision.
All eight phase markers closed; Phase 7 carries a Reasoned Exclusions record and Phase 8 carries the scoped-verification notes for the batch gate deferral.

next_steps: Nothing blocks completion. Four follow-ups are recorded in the summary rather than left implicit: give CERTIFY its own IO.asTask budget (its tableau rebuilds are untimed, which is what truncated ModalTemporalBoolean); flush records incrementally so a killed run is survivable; theorem_library_countermodels is the consumer of data/theorem-library-countermodels.jsonl; and no producer of a RawCertificate from a tableau branch exists, so the ZTime certificate grade is unreachable until one does.
